mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.subtitle, b.description, b.cover_image, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_article ba JOIN articles a2 ON a2.id = ba.article_id AND a2.is_deleted = 0 AND a2.status = 1 WHERE ba.book_id = b.id) AS chapter_count FROM book b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.status DESC, b.updated_at DESC
SELECT id, title, subtitle, description, cover_image, status FROM book WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT ba.article_id AS articleId, COALESCE(NULLIF(ba.chapter_title, ''), a.title) AS chapterTitle, a.title AS articleTitle, ba.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM book_article ba JOIN articles a ON a.id = ba.article_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 WHERE ba.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY ba.sort_order ASC
